results.id: L|summary
results.detail: Scope note verified: 14 pipelines, 10 disabled (Active POA, Cancel Active, Cancel Duplicate, Canncel POA main, 4 future-funds, Transfer Request, Out of Date); only DML via SQL: Update Pension Joining (gen_pensionjoiningbase) and disabled Update TransferRequest; [CRM]=Psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM; config file DTSX:11. POAMainMonthsToAdd from gen_etlvariable via [CRM] verified. But the path list in [1] is not complete/conditional: (a) AJ "creation failed -> still marked" holds only if the CRM error message fits wstr(50); (b) in Pension Joining a failed link attempt never marks the joining but fails the data flow; (c) every SQL-marked pension joining is routed to an ETL Warning script that throws on NULL columns, failing the PJ data flow and the package; (d) the PJ "additional joining" rule misses the eviction case. Standard SSIS runtime behaviour (not visible in the DTSX itself): a generated typed getter (Buffer.GetString/GetGuid/GetInt32) on a NULL column throws ColumnIsNullException; assigning a string longer than the declared column length to an output buffer column throws DoesNotFitBufferException.

wrongUnits.problem: States unconditionally that AJ joinings are marked when creation failed, and omits PJ failure behaviours (failed link -> data-flow failure, ETL Warning NULL-read failure after SQL marking, eviction of an earlier-read joining).
wrongUnits.correct: AJ Create POA Main catch (main.cs:271-276, DTSX 22866; annotation catch DTSX 22891) assigns ex.Message to ErrorBuffer.ErrorMessage declared wstr(50) (DTSX 24454). If the CRM exception message is longer than 50 characters the assignment itself throws inside the catch, the component fails and the data flow fails; creation is deferred to EndOfRowset (main.cs:452-455) while Success is synchronous, so rows of the last buffer are then not passed to Update Automated Joining. "Marked even when creation failed" is therefore conditional on the message length (data not in the files). PJ Update POA Main catch writes "Pension Joining Id: " (20 chars) + guid (36) + ... into ErrorDescription declared wstr(50) (DTSX 37175, 37752) - always longer than 50, so a failed link throws inside the catch, the component fails and the data flow fails; the row is not passed via Output 0 to Union All 2 and is NOT marked 3. Update Pension Joining OLE DB Command Output -> Union All 1 Input 2, which has no input columns (DTSX 36886-36888), so every successfully SQL-marked row reaches ETL Warning with WarningTitle/RecordKey/WarningDescription NULL; ETL Warning main.cs:65 (DTSX 35738) reads Row.WarningTitle without an IsNull check (getter DTSX 35848-35853) -> ColumnIsNullException, no try/catch -> the ETL Warning component fails, the Create POA Main For Pension Joining data flow fails on the first marked row, and (all constraints are Success) End ETL Process record does not run and the package fails. Which joinings are created/marked before the failure depends on buffer timing and data volume. Eviction case (main.cs:67-84, DTSX 31626): when the ID's POA Main points to joining J1 and another joining J2 of the same ID is read BEFORE J1, J2 first becomes the candidate and is then replaced by the IsOther marker when J1 is read; J2 is neither created nor marked although it was the first one read.

If the CRM exception message is longer than 50 characters the assignment itself throws inside the catch, the component fails and the data flow fails; creation is deferred to EndOfRowset (main.cs:452-455) while Success is synchronous, so rows of the last buffer are then not passed to Update Automated Joining.
